notes.title: 🛠️Dev Log | v0.2.15 Update
notes.content:
Hello, Wanderers!
This is the development team of Wonderia! ✨
Here comes a small update during our Playtest — mainly focused on improving multiplayer experiences and adding a new device we’re still a bit unsure about:
the Hand-crank Drill.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836228/6e610b5ccfd26126cbe88957855654fc0c6e31b5.gif

We’d love to hear your thoughts about it (or anything else!) through Discord ✨

[hr][/hr]
✨ Update Highlights: v0.2.15

🗺️ Bidirectional Map Sync in Multiplayer
Now, hosts and visitors can sync each other's maps using the Map Workbench!
Previously, visitors could only receive the host’s progress, while the host couldn’t view theirs — sorry for the inconvenience! 🙇
Since maps are essential infrastructure for multiplayer, let us know if anything still feels off — we’ll continue improving it.

⛏️ New: Hand-crank Drill (Experimental!)
A new experimental tool that lets you mine giant rocks and copper nodes already generated in the world.

During Playtest, we’ve received many questions about “how to get more copper”.
While the issue will naturally be solved later via expanded maps and powered tools, some players suggested providing an interim solution — so here it is.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836228/543e1dc355eded206badbc59d336a1c9753705bd.gif

The Hand Crank Drill is:
Manual, not automated
Slow, but can mine large ore blocks
Multiplayer-friendly — everyone can help speed it up

But we still have doubts:

 Is the unlock cost reasonable?
 Is the experience too “grindy”?
 Is this just a demo-exclusive stopgap before automation?


Let us know what you think after trying it out!

How to get the Hand Crank Drill:

 In newly generated saves, you’ll find one placed outside the treetop hut near a giant copper node
 Defeat the BOSS “Stonefeather” to unlock the crafting recipe (at the Construction Workbench)
 Can occasionally be purchased from merchant Rohen


📌 Other Small Updates

 Multiplayer reward scaling: Initial quest and BOSS drops now scale with player count
 Improved hotkey hints: “Drop on Ground” now shown in the backpack UI for easier item trading
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836228/6589cc7ac8585374db08f3a6d2ea59d949056a42.gif

 New copper sprinkler: Wider range than the cross sprinkler, available at the upgraded workbench
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836228/7b873200e0212f99cd6cdcb7f570a8c194fc766f.gif

 Building placement feedback: Capsule buildings now show footprint areas when placing
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836228/110331e64be5c7a0aff4d464b831668bca0b26d3.gif

 Shift modifier added: Prevents accidentally emptying containers when looting
 Community access in-game: You can now find us more easily if you need help or want to send feedback



🎙️ One Last Note: Thank You for Your Voice
This is a small patch — but everything here was inspired by community feedback.
We know many systems — from resource gathering and building rewards to transformation pacing and combat satisfaction — are still being refined.

That’s why your voice means so much to us.
If you’re willing, come by and share your experiences: Discord


We read every message.
Thank you again for your support and patience 💗
We’ll keep listening — and hope to meet you again on this strange and lovely planet✨

— Rock&Dash Studio

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2593340/_Wonderia/

notes.title: 🛠️Dev Log | v0.2.14 Update
notes.content:
✨ Hello from the Wonderia Dev Team!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836228/6f9c9de2e1cda71c5c9fa2e3788d33287b2ae0cc.png
First of all — thank you to everyone who played and shared feedback.  
Beyond the kind words and encouragement, many players also pointed out clear issues: grind-heavy tasks, unclear guidance, and overly difficult monsters, just to name a few. We took your input seriously, and this update is our attempt to address them meaningfully.

This version also includes two major additions:

 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Multiplayer Mode (up to 8 players)  
 🌍 Support for 10 languages  


Huge thanks to our publishing partner IndieArk, and to the localization team who worked closely with us to ensure this update could support 10 languages. We’re excited to share this strange little world with players around the globe.

If you'd like to follow development, share suggestions, or just connect with other players, we warmly invite you to join our Discord: https://discord.gg/y3rY4XhpB5

[hr][/hr]

✨ What’s New in v0.2.14

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836228/3545e451737104b500ca2c6682cee0c3ad2a186d.gif

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Multiplayer Now Available  
- Up to 8 players can now team up to explore, build, and fight together  
- Network syncing and stability improvements

🌍 Language Support  
- Now supports 10 languages  
- Existing translations polished for clarity and consistency

🎮 Keybinding & Gamepad Improvements  
- Most controls are now fully remappable  
- Gamepad support and input switching improved

[hr][/hr]

📌 Improvements Based on the First Playtest

🔍 World & Exploration  
- Added multiple fixed teleport points to reduce backtracking

⚔️ Combat & Bosses  
- Stonefeather Boss reworked with new phase AI and territorial mechanics  
- Reduced early-game monster stats for better balance  
- Improved monster attack and death animations

⚖️ Pacing & Rewards  
- Lowered early task requirements and reduced gathering repetition  
- More equipment drop variety added

🌱 Farming System Updates  
- Cranberry can now be farmed as a renewable crop  
- Early-game auto sprinkler introduced for faster farming

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836228/92a43661edbe45128e3b4e784468d9c0d65662e8.gif

📌 Other Changes & Fixes

- Added new stone-tier weapon series  
- Improved control feel for spears and dodge rings  
- Shop UI now supports item previews  
- Inventory system now supports auto-replace and destroy

[hr][/hr]

A Final Note

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836228/6bdb23bb8c5951e00f08af6a0b34a5f9fd1dfbc3.gif

This might look like a small update on Wonderia — but it means a lot to us.  
Not just in terms of features or fixes, but as a reflection of what we’ve learned from real players.
We still have a long way to go. But we’re listening, and we’re building — and we hope to see you again, somewhere out there on this strange and gentle planet.

Rock&Dash Studio

→ View Wonderia on Steam

June 13 – June 27

Simultaneously available on both Steam and Wegame!


Trailer[previewyoutube="E_1jE9qMtFg;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 🌟Hello, Explorers—and Happy New Year from the Wonderia Team!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836228/bf46cae54d0dce84e95fd250e4c1f348ffb58b75.jpg
It’s been a long time since our last dev log way back in February. We know—we’ve been heads-down pushing Wonderia forward, and game development always proves trickier than you’d think! At the start of 2025, we wanted to pop in, say hello 👋, and share some of the biggest strides we’ve taken over the past year. 🚀

Development Progress Recap
This year has been packed with growth and new features. Here’s a quick rundown:

[olist]
 Trying Out an Extraction Survival Mode🏃‍♂️
We’ve begun experimenting with an extraction survival mode, which blends high-stakes elements into our sandbox setting. We realize it’s an unconventional approach—merging extraction-style gameplay with building and crafting is a risk—but we hope it brings an interesting layer to Wonderia. We’re still refining this idea, so we welcome your thoughts once you get a chance to try it. 

 Skill System Implementation🛠️
We’ve introduced a skill system aimed at giving your character’s progression more depth. It’s still a work in progress, but we’re hoping it helps every player find a unique playstyle, whether you’re more into combat, crafting, or exploration .

 Expanding Biomes, POIs, and Cute Enemies🐾
Our art and design teams have been busy adding new biomes, Points of Interest, and enemies to keep you on your toes. We’re also working on a completely new biome🌱 that’s still under development. We can’t wait to share more details once it’s further along. 

 Ongoing Art and UI Overhaul✨
We’ve spent a lot of time fine-tuning Wonderia’s manga-inspired art style. Alongside that, we’re overhauling the UI to make it clearer and easier to use. 🖥️ It’s been a significant effort, and we’re still polishing things up, but we hope these improvements will make your experiences in Wonderia more enjoyable. 😊

 Joystick and Steam Deck Support🕹️
We’re happy to share that joystick and Steam Deck support is in the works—though not fully implemented yet, we’re aiming to include it in our upcoming beta demo.

 Multiplayer Stability and Public Servers🤝
Multiplayer stability has been a major focus this past year. We’ve come a long way, but there’s still more to do. We’re also preparing public server support, so eventually you’ll be able to hop in with others around the globe more easily. ✨
[/olist]

Thank you for sticking with us throughout 2024. From our whole team at Rock & Dash—and our new friends at IndieArk—we wish you a wonderful start to 2025🏮🐍, and we look forward to hearing what you think in the coming months. 

Stay connected:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2593340/Wonderia/

Until next time—take care, and we’ll see you in Wonderia!! 🌌🎮🚀
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836228/6788416a68dca2a58cc2a278557c3dc4e5d48ee3.png

Rock & Dash Team✨

notes.title: 🌟 Welcome to Wonderia - Our First Update! 🌟
notes.content:
🙋Hello, explorers! We're Rock & Dash, a team deeply passionate about crafting multiplayer sandbox experiences that ignite creativity and foster endless gameplay. Today, we're excited to share the journey of Wonderia, our latest venture into a world of mystery, exploration, and creativity, all wrapped up in a 2D open-world survival craft game with a top-down perspective.

🎮Why We Started This Project

Our adventure began 18 months ago, fueled by a shared passion for the sandbox genre and a vision to infuse it with the captivating manga art style we adore. Despite being newcomers on Steam, our team unites over a decade of experience in game development, bringing a wealth of knowledge and enthusiasm to this project. Wonderia is our dream project, born from our desire to blend immersive gameplay elements—building, crafting, mining, battling, forming friendships with NPCs, dungeon exploration—into a unique experience that resonates with fans of the genre and newcomers alike. Our goal is to create a game that not only pays homage to the sandbox genre we love but also introduces a distinct artistic flair and a rich tapestry of gameplay mechanics that encourage creativity, exploration, and adventure.

🚀Milestones & Progress

As we forge ahead with Wonderia's development, we're excited to highlight our recent milestones:


 🌟Core Development: The backbone of the game has been solidly implemented, featuring a progressively generated world, an intricate NPC system, engaging dungeon exploration, and also multiplayer functionality.
 🌟Content Progress: We are nearly complete with the first two biomes, which are not just visually distinct but also packed with layered structures, 10+ dungeons, and hundreds of items.
 🌟Upcoming Demo: Final preparations are underway for our demo, multiplayer included. This demo will not only serve as a significant milestone but also offer players a firsthand look at what makes Wonderia special.


Please 🌟WISHLIST🌟 Wonderia and follow us for all the latest updates. Your thoughts and feedback are invaluable as we shape the game together. A heartfelt thank you for your support; it truly helps bring Wonderia to life.
